name: @mortgage/pod-runtime
description: In-browser pods: one wasm Solid server per pod in a service worker, snapshot persistence, trap recovery, Lens events, organisation agents, host-mode bridge.

scripts.build: node scripts/glue-factory.mjs && tsc --project tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.lint: biome check src/*.ts src/host src/client src/agents src/bridge src/sw test scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json tsconfig.sw.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && tsc --project tsconfig.sw.json
